# Kø ved udgangen - globale aktiemarkeder i fælles nedsmeltning

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-06  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish Millionærklubben episode (EuroInvestor, 2026-11-06) recorded during a broad global sell-off after the US midterm election. The selling was driven by doubts about data-centre and AI capex, though bond yields were falling. Guests Lars Svendsen (oil, shipping and materials) and Lars Persson (technical analysis) call it a warning sign, but neither panics: they see a correction rather than a crash. They answer listener questions on oil and tanker stocks, defence, Novo Nordisk, medtech, NTG, Cbrain, Nobia and iron-ore miners. Svendsen notes physical Brent moving into contango, which could mean the oil price has peaked.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 RHM — Rheinmetall | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fell 16% to about 841; Svendsen's buy level is about 750.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen (guest) reads the drop as a sign of peace in the east and would buy only if the price falls to his long-calculated level of about 750. It is a watch-for-entry call, not an immediate buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- peace agreement removes the rearmament premium
- price does not reach 750

> *"Jeg har for længe siden regnet ud 750, det er det, jeg vil være med."*

---

### 🟠 CBRAIN — Cbrain | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Up about 126% in 3 months with an uptrend and high volume; Persson has moved it back to his candidate list but not into his portfolio.

#### Reasoning

Persson (guest) sees an upward trend and strong turnover. A US subsidiary could open a large market. Only about 20 million shares exist, so retail traders drive the price, which makes it volatile.

#### Sell Triggers

- trend breaks
- US expansion fails to gain traction

> *"jeg har pusset den af og taget den frem fra kandidatbænken, men jeg har ikke sat den helt ind i portføljen"*

---

### 🟡 PBR — Petrobras | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Svendsen holds it and is not selling yet, but is weighing whether the oil price has peaked.

#### Reasoning

Physical Brent in contango suggests supply is easing. However, the Iran situation is unresolved and refinery capacity is damaged. If oil falls below $80, oil stocks should fall too.

#### Sell Triggers

- oil falls below $80
- Iran conflict resolved and oil supply normalises

> *"Så vil du tage lidt af de der olieakter? Nej, ikke endnu."*

---

### 🟡 ENI — Eni | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Svendsen holds it alongside Petrobras and BP and has not sold yet.

#### Reasoning

Same oil thesis as Petrobras: contango signals easing supply, but Iran risk and lost refinery capacity support prices.

#### Sell Triggers

- oil falls below $80

---

### 🟡 BP — BP | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Svendsen will not start his trimming with BP because of its Iraq expansion plan.

#### Reasoning

BP has large Iraq expansion plans that are on hold because of the Iran war, which gives it upside if the conflict ends. It faces the same oil-price risk as the other oil holdings.

#### Sell Triggers

- oil falls below $80
- Iraq plan cancelled

> *"Og der vil du starte med at tage af BP? Nej."*

---

### 🟡 FRO — Frontline | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Svendsen's largest tanker position, though he is trimming it slightly.

#### Reasoning

Tanker rates are strong across the sector. He is trimming to rotate into Capital Tankers and Volare.

#### Sell Triggers

- shortage of physical crude leaves tankers idle

> *"Det er Frontline stadigvæk, selvom jeg trapper lidt ned."*

---

### 🔴 DNORD — Norden | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Svendsen sold Norden to buy Capital Tankers.

#### Reasoning

A rotation within shipping rather than a negative call on Norden.

> *"jeg solgte Norden og købte Capital Tankers"*

---

### 🟢 VLCC — Volare Shipping | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Trial position bought at 165, now 155, target 250.

#### Reasoning

New Oslo-listed VLCC owner with 6 vessels growing to 16. Its newbuilds can carry refined products, for example diesel from China to Europe. Svendsen sees about 60% upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- tanker rates collapse
- newbuild program delayed

> *"Og jeg har regnet ud, at den skal være 250 hver."*

---

### 🟡 NTG — NTG Nordic | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Up 76% in 6 months but has lost momentum. Persson advises a stop-loss or partial profit-taking and readiness to buy back.

#### Reasoning

Persson (TA) expects a consolidation pause after a sharp rise. Protect gains with a stop-loss rather than exit outright, and be ready to buy back.

#### Sell Triggers

- stop-loss hit
- breaks below the 330-340 range

> *"Så sæt et eller andet stop loss, hvor man vil tage noget ud, eller tage det hele af."*

---

### ⛔ NOBI — Nobia | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Down 66% this year; kitchen demand is weak and it expanded capacity at the wrong time.

#### Reasoning

Persson: consumers are spending on travel, not kitchen renovations. Nobia over-expanded after COVID and is left with empty capacity. Cut losses, since it will take years to recover.

> *"Så nej, jeg skal ikke have nogen af dem der."*

---

### 🟢 VALE — Vale | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Svendsen added a third to his position; high dividend; iron ore is an oligopoly.

#### Reasoning

Prefers iron-ore producers to steelmakers because three producers dominate the market. Vale also has rail and shipping assets. He expects to collect about 25 in dividends within 5 years.

#### Sell Triggers

- iron ore price collapse
- aluminium/energy issues in Brazil worsen

> *"Jeg må indrømme, jeg tror, at jeg får 25 fra dem, inden der er gået fem år."*

---

### 🟠 RIO — Rio Tinto | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Svendsen calls it a very solid, diversified company; buy only at a low price.

#### Reasoning

Diversified miner moving into lithium. Quality is not the issue; valuation is. Svendsen has not bought yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- valuation stays too high

> *"Rio er et meget, meget ordentligt firma, så det er mere et spørgsmål om prisen er god nok."*

---

### ⛔ BHP — BHP | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Svendsen strongly dislikes the company.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen expresses distaste for BHP's conduct but gives no detailed fundamental case.

> *"Det er BHP i Australien, som jeg har en stor afsky for."*

---

### 🟢 KOG — Kongsberg Gruppen | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Up 60% this year with full order books; Persson would take a small position.

#### Reasoning

Strong missile and defence franchise and thick order books. Risk: a peace deal would trigger a knee-jerk sell-off across defence stocks.

#### Sell Triggers

- peace agreement signed
- defence stocks enter prolonged lull

> *"Man kunne godt tage en lille snas af Kongsberg-gruppen. Ja, det vil jeg nok gerne."*

---

### 🟢 SAAB-B — Saab | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Persson would also take some Saab: surveillance-plane orders and a new combat boat.

#### Reasoning

Defence demand is ongoing, but there is peace-deal risk, and today's levels may be the top for a long time.

#### Sell Triggers

- peace agreement signed

> *"Og det samme med Saab"*

---

### 🔴 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Persson is selling, saying Novo will be number two and lose share to competitors.

#### Reasoning

Persson is fed up with his losing position and expects market-share erosion. He will wait for the market to settle and buy something else.

> *"Den skal simpelthen ud, og så skal vi finde på noget andet."*

---

### 🟢 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Svendsen disagrees with Persson: results were very positive and cagrisema and MASH are coming; he would buy more.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen argues share loss is natural from a 100% starting point. The realistic market is about 100 million patients and only 5.6 million are treated now. Capex is winding down and management is tightening control.

#### Sell Triggers

- cagrisema approval fails
- continued share loss to Lilly

> *"derfor vil jeg jo stå faktisk til at købe flere"*

---

### 🟡 AMBU-B — Ambu | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Persson bought it back privately; uptrend after the reset of targets; RSI near 70, so he is considering taking profit.

#### Reasoning

The market rewarded the CEO for cutting targets, closing one price gap. The trend is up, but overbought conditions suggest a pause, and he may hold rather than overtrade.

#### Sell Triggers

- RSI overbought leads to pullback
- trend breaks

> *"så det kan godt være, at den skal blive liggende lidt i portføljen"*

---

### 🟠 COLO-B — Coloplast | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Market has forgiven the target cut and momentum is back, but RSI is near 70; Persson has not bought.

#### Reasoning

Same pattern as Ambu. Persson would look to buy during consolidation rather than now.

#### Sell Triggers

- momentum fades

> *"Ej, den har jeg ikke købt endnu, men jeg kan jo godt se, at der sker jo det samme."*

---
